content: Quanthacks now links read-only to algoterminal-data: docs/algoterminal.md owns the contract, make graph resolves it, and make check runs it when the sibling checkout exists (ALGOTERMINAL_DIR, default ~/algoterminal-data) and skips otherwise. The link checks that node_resolved nodes exist in graph/quant_graph.yaml, node_proposed nodes do not, source_resolved sources exist in graph/source_inventory.yaml, source_proposed do not, every edge endpoint is declared, and every declaration is used. Audit finding: against 7517 graph node ids our node space is absent (no datacenter, compute, GPU, interconnection, transformer, turbine, cooling, backlog, guidance or 8-K nodes; the 63 feature nodes are weather, tanker and refinery observation). Reuse for data: source:sec (EDGAR), source:eia-930, source:fred, source:market (yfinance/stooq), source:landsat, source:nasa-firms, source:copernicus. Must add: source:eia-860m, source:databento-options, source:ornn-ocpi, source:hyperliquid-archive. First chain declared at docs/chains/t-capacity-revision.jsonl.

Do not load memory/shared.json with hippo import --file: it parses the JSON as plain text and writes one memory per line, flooding the store with fragment entries such as a bare key string. Use scripts/memory_absorb.py, which compares normalized content against the local export and calls hippo remember once per missing entry. It is idempotent.

Repo: https://github.com/sebastbernal2-ship-it/gqh-delivery-gap (public, main). Layout: docs/ (brief.md frozen track rules, CURRENT.md generated from docs/theses/index.jsonl, theses/, decisions.md append-only, workflow.md parallel-work rules, memory.md, onboarding.md, alignment.md, thinking/, writing/, inbox/, history/), src/<component>/ with its own README, hpc/<approach>/ with its own README, results/, memory/shared.json. Commands: make sync, save M=, current, check, test, doctor, claims, overlaps, worktree NAME=, share, absorb, remember M=. Rules: one writer per file, decompose by concern with INTERFACE.md as the seam, branch when paths overlap, push branches immediately, rebase before committing, merge same day. The parked delivery-gap attempt lives on branch archive/w0-delivery-gap including its own out-of-sample split; nothing on main asserts it. Vishnu's equity-first research handoff is in docs/inbox/vishnu-2026-10-03/.

Repo: https://github.com/sebastbernal2-ship-it/gqh-delivery-gap (public, main). Structure: docs/ holds the written layer (brief.md frozen track rules, CURRENT.md generated from docs/theses/index.jsonl, theses/ one record per claim, decisions.md append-only, workflow.md the parallel-work rules, memory.md the memory protocol, onboarding.md, alignment.md, thinking/, writing/, inbox/, history/). src/<component>/ for code with its own README. hpc/<approach>/ for HiPerGator jobs, one directory per approach. results/ for numbers the note quotes. Commands: make sync, make save M=..., make current, make check (secrets, ledger, structure, paths, view freshness), make test, make doctor, make claims, make overlaps, make worktree NAME=..., make share, make absorb, make remember M=... . Parallel work: one writer per file, decompose by concern with INTERFACE.md as the seam; branches pushed immediately, rebased often, merged the same day; archive/w0-delivery-gap holds the parked delivery-gap attempt.

docs/alignment.md is now the unitary vision and method, synthesised 2026-10-03 from all three handoffs. The vision in one sentence: we trade the gap between a promise and a delivery, measured as a revision against an earlier public expectation, and every tool is subordinate to that. Method: seven steps (mechanism plus simplest rival, counterparty, earlier expectation, measurable quantity and units, evidence audit, falsifier and baseline and costs before returns, complexity only with development evidence); tag every arrow of the reasoning chain observed, inferred or untested. Confidence is local to a claim and follows a ladder that must not be skipped: documentation says capable, entitlement, downloaded, valid point-in-time panel, correct label, calibrated forecast, correct joint tails, trades after costs. Realized outcomes are labels never inputs; availability times bind; identity survives aggregation. Adequacy is independent shocks, not calendar length. No advanced method is mandatory, quantum has no standing role, and infrastructure is never an argument. Recorded divergences between the handoffs: component taxonomy, pilot instrument (PWR base case versus NVDA/GOOGL pilots), measurement object (Aidan's critical path versus Vishnu's backlog guidance revisions, which are complementary), horizon (ten sessions unvalidated), and Jev/Laya identity (Aidan correct).

Committing in projects/quanthacks from this harness fails on index writes: git add and commit report a missing lock file error although no lock file and no git process exist (read only git works; the same error appeared in the algoterminal checkout). Working path: set GIT_INDEX_FILE to a temp path, run read-tree HEAD, add the paths, commit, then copy that temp index over the repository git index via a computed path so git status returns to clean. Also: the SEC refuses a User-Agent containing a URL (an HTML 403 that mimics throttling); a plain project name plus contact address form is accepted.
